label: B25-COREMARK-UART-BACKPRESSURE
title: Prevent CoreMark summary loss under JTAG-UART TX FIFO backpressure
reads: T-042 CoreMark firmware and host parser
scope: Keep the BRAM monitor's JTAG-UART TX wait finite while allowing a connected slow host to drain a 64-byte FIFO; add a paced-drain vendor-timing SoC regression for complete CoreMark v output.
acceptance: The exact CMSELF record reaches the host parser under paced 64-byte FIFO drain with zero TX drops; existing startup, t, DDR m, RXDBG/RXPATH/RXCPU, and CoreMark checksum regressions remain green. No score is reported unless full c raw output passes the strict parser.
forbidden_regions: CoreMark algorithm or expected CRC change

L1: behavioral and vendor-timed SoC smoke with paced TX drain
